download_model: download the expanded_and_multiobjective_1024 light whoami model to the specified datapath
run_download: run the download function to fetch the expanded attention multi-objective model v1.0
test_download: test the download function by calling it with a valid datapath argument
review_download: review the download function that wraps download_with_model_type for the expanded_and_multiobjective_1024 model
summarize_download: summarize the download function which downloads the light whoami expanded attention multi-objective model
